mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = '지급' THEN commission ELSE 0 END), 0) as totalPaidAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = '미지급' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as unpaidCount, COALESCE(AVG(commission_rate), 0) as avgCommissionRate FROM "h_settlement"

SELECT s.settlement_id AS settlementId, s.gym_id AS gymId, s.commission, s.commission_rate AS commissionRate, s.settle_month AS settleMonth, s.status FROM "h_settlement" s JOIN "h_member" m ON m.gym_id = s.gym_id WHERE m.username = #{username} AND UPPER(m.role) = 'OWNER' AND s.status = '미지급' AND s.expense_id IS NULL ORDER BY s.settle_month DESC, s.settlement_id DESC

SELECT s.settlement_id AS settlementId, s.gym_id AS gymId, s.commission, s.commission_rate AS commissionRate, s.settle_month AS settleMonth, s.status FROM "h_settlement" s JOIN "h_member" m ON m.gym_id = s.gym_id WHERE m.username = #{username} AND UPPER(m.role) = 'OWNER' AND s.settlement_id = #{settlementId} AND s.status = '미지급' AND s.expense_id IS NULL
SELECT gym_id FROM "h_member" WHERE username = #{username} AND UPPER(role) = 'OWNER'

SELECT s.settlement_id as settlementId, s.gym_id as gymId, g.gym_name as gymName, s.commission, s.settled_at as settledAt, s.commission_rate as commissionRate, s.settle_month as settleMonth, s.status, s.expense_id as expenseId FROM "h_settlement" s LEFT JOIN "h_gym" g ON s.gym_id = g.gym_id WHERE s.gym_id = #{gymId} AND s.settle_month = #{month}

SELECT e.expense_id as expenseId, e.gym_id as gymId, e.data_id as dataId, s.settlement_id as settlementId, e.expense_name as expenseName, e.expense_date as expenseDate, COALESCE(NULLIF(e.expense_price, 0), s.commission, 0) as expensePrice, COALESCE(NULLIF(e.expense_rate, 0), s.commission_rate, 0) as expenseRate FROM "h_expense" e LEFT JOIN "h_settlement" s ON s.expense_id = e.expense_id WHERE e.gym_id = (SELECT gym_id FROM "h_member" WHERE username = #{username})
AND TO_CHAR(e.expense_date, 'YYYY-MM') = #{pager.month}
AND e.expense_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{pager.searchKeyword}, '%')
ORDER BY e.expense_date DESC, e.expense_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO "h_expense" (expense_id, gym_id, data_id, expense_name, expense_date, expense_price, expense_rate, origin_item_id) VALUES (default, #{gymId}, #{dataId}, #{expenseName}, #{expenseDate}, #{expensePrice}, #{expenseRate}, #{originItemId})
mapper.update: UPDATE "h_settlement" SET status = '지급', settled_at = #{settledAt}, expense_id = #{expenseId} WHERE settlement_id = #{settlementId} AND status = '미지급' AND expense_id IS NULL
mapper.select: WITH locked AS (SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(-#{dataId})) SELECT CAST(#{dataId} AS bigint) FROM locked
mapper.update: UPDATE "h_settlement" s SET status = '미지급', settled_at = NULL, expense_id = NULL FROM "h_expense" e, "h_member" m WHERE s.expense_id = e.expense_id AND e.expense_id = #{expenseId} AND e.gym_id = m.gym_id AND m.username = #{username} AND UPPER(m.role) = 'OWNER'
mapper.select: SELECT p.gym_id AS gymId, CAST(SUM(p.pay_price * contract.normalized_rate) AS int8) AS commission, SUM(p.pay_price * contract.normalized_rate) / NULLIF(SUM(p.pay_price), 0) AS commissionRate FROM "h_payment" p JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT CASE WHEN c.contract_rate >= 1 THEN c.contract_rate / 100.0 ELSE c.contract_rate END AS normalized_rate FROM "h_contract_data" c WHERE c.gym_id = p.gym_id AND c.contract = 1 AND c.contract_rate IS NOT NULL AND c.signed_at IS NOT NULL AND c.signed_at::date <= p.pay_date AND c.start_date <= p.pay_date AND (c.end_date IS NULL OR c.end_date >= p.pay_date) ORDER BY c.start_date DESC, c.signed_at DESC, c.data_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) contract ON TRUE WHERE p.pay_date >= #{startDate} AND p.pay_date <= #{endDate} GROUP BY p.gym_id
WITH locked AS (SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(#{gymId})) SELECT CAST(#{gymId} AS bigint) FROM locked
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO "h_settlement" (gym_id, commission, commission_rate, settle_month, status) VALUES (#{gymId}, #{commission}, #{commissionRate}, #{settleMonth}, '미지급')
mapper.select: SELECT d.data_id as dataId, d.contract, d.gym_id as gymId, d.sender_id as senderId, d.receiver_id as receiverId, d.receiver_name as receiverName, d.status, d.start_date as startDate, d.end_date as endDate, d.amount, d.contract_rate as contractRate, d.quantity, d.issue_date as issueDate, d.signed_at as signedAt, d.manager_id as managerId FROM "h_contract_data" d WHERE d.sender_id = #{username} AND d.contract = 2 AND d.status IN ('SIGNED', 'ACTIVE') AND d.data_id NOT IN ( SELECT data_id FROM "h_expense" WHERE data_id IS NOT NULL ) ORDER BY d.issue_date DESC, d.data_id DESC LIMIT #{pager.pageSize} OFFSET #{pager.offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "h_contract_data" d WHERE d.sender_id = #{username} AND d.contract = 2 AND d.status IN ('SIGNED', 'ACTIVE') AND d.data_id NOT IN ( SELECT data_id FROM "h_expense" WHERE data_id IS NOT NULL )

SELECT d.data_id as dataId, d.contract, d.gym_id as gymId, d.receiver_name as receiverName, d.signed_at as signedAt FROM "h_contract_data" d WHERE d.contract = 2 AND d.status = 'SIGNED' AND d.signed_at >= now() - interval '1 day' AND d.data_id NOT IN ( SELECT data_id FROM "h_expense" WHERE data_id IS NOT NULL ) ORDER BY d.data_id DESC
